- Overestimate prices after recent spikes, especially when sentiment is negative or volatile.  
- Underestimate when sentiment is strongly negative and prices are trending down.  
- Adjust downward if sentiment turns positive after a sharp rise — model tends to overreact.  
- Lag correction: if true outcome is lower than forecast in early days of 30d horizon, reduce later forecast values.  
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is above 10-15% of recent high, reduce by 5-10% unless sentiment supports continuation.  
- Avoid overconfidence in sentiment-driven momentum — if sentiment is neutral or slightly positive, don’t assume sustained rally.  
- When sentiment is consistently negative over 3-5 days, reduce forecast by 3-7% to account for risk-off behavior.
